./autogen.sh && OPENSSL_PREFIX="$(brew --prefix openssl@3)" LIBEVENT_PREFIX="$(brew --prefix libevent)" && ./configure --with-openssl-dir="$OPENSSL_PREFIX" --with-libevent-dir="$LIBEVENT_PREFIX" --disable-asciidoc --disable-lzma --disable-zstd && make clean && make V=1 -j"$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)" 2>&1 | tee build.log >/dev/null && grep -Eo '[^[:space:]]+\.c' build.log | sort -u > libtor_sources.txt
